question: When hovering directly over the June point (the rightmost, tallest point on the chart), what value does the tooltip show?
description: Bound data is identical to clean.html; points are drawn at their true positions, with June the rightmost/tallest point at 90 and May second-to-last at 47. Attack fakes: the invisible Delaunay/Voronoi hover hit-area is built from a jittered copy of the point coordinates (each site's x shifted to the next month's true x position) instead of the true coordinates, so the hit-area covering June's true on-screen location actually belongs to the site carrying May's datum -- hovering exactly over June's visual point shows '$47k' instead of the true '$90k'.
